questions.title: Float Precision Equality
questions.description:
What does this snippet print, and what causes it?

print(0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3)
questions.Option1: False — binary floating-point stores 0.1 + 0.2 as a value slightly above 0.3
questions.Option2: True — Python rounds the comparison automatically
questions.Option3: 0.3 — the expression evaluates to the literal
questions.Option4: 0.30000000000000004 — the comparison prints the computed value

questions.title: Inconsistent Indentation Result
questions.description: A script has a block where one line is indented 4 spaces and the next line at the same level is indented 2 spaces. What happens when you run it?
questions.Option1: Python raises IndentationError because lines in the same block must be indented consistently
questions.Option2: It runs fine — indentation is purely cosmetic
questions.Option3: The line with 2 spaces is silently ignored
questions.Option4: Python automatically treats the 2-space line as a deeper nested block
